title: Claude Can Build Your Entire Shopify Site in Minutes 🤯
description: Claude Can Build Your Entire Shopify Site in Minutes 🤯
transcript: Claude is absolutely insane. You can now create full shopify sites in minutes. First, you have it create a brand kit. Second, you have it scan your product, the language, the offer, the audience, and the customer objections, all from your current site. Third, you run it through this conversion rate playbook right here. Then it designs and executes the website for you. Just look at the site we built using it. Covers buyer psychology, problem framing, credibility offers, conversion rate frameworks, upsells, cross sells, full product walkthroughs, and so much more. And it will literally take you from a basic Shopify store to a perfect high converting website in under 10 minutes. Comment Claude, and I'll send you the full strategy.
